description: What your Diavgis plan allows right now (the same for an API key and a connected account): plan, calls used this period, calls remaining, per-minute rate, page-size and pagination caps, and when the period resets. Free — this call is not counted against the quota. Useful for sizing a long job.
name: get_quota

max_pages.description: pagination depth cap; deeper pages return an error, narrow with filters instead

period_reset.description: ISO date when used resets to 0

used.description: calls consumed this period (REST + MCP share one counter)

title: Plan, Usage and Remaining Calls
